description: Import a Substack subscriber export the user uploaded (the CSV from their publication's Subscribers page). Every row becomes or matches a contact tagged 'Substack subscriber' with plan and status. Find the file with search_graph_objects (type 'file') and pass its object_id, or part of the filename as name. `publication` is the publication's subdomain (the part before .substack.com); ask if you do not know it.

name.description: Part of the filename, when the object_id is unknown.
